rows.jyutping: deoi3 A ge3 tai2 m4 hei2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday construction for contempt or disdain toward a person or thing.

example.english: Everyone can see my contempt for him.
example.traditional: 大家都睇得出我對佢嘅睇唔起
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1 ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 tai2 m4 hei2

rows.note: Use this for the legal offence of contempt of court, rather than ordinary scorn.

example.english: The defendant was charged with contempt for refusing to obey the injunction.
example.traditional: 被告因為拒絕遵守禁制令，被控藐視法庭罪
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 jan1 wai6 keoi5 zyut6 zyun1 sau2 gam3 zai3 ling6 bei6 hung3 miu5 si6 faat3 ting4 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this for legal contempt involving a legislative body, not contempt toward an ordinary person.

example.english: They were accused of contempt of the Legislative Council after refusing to answer questions.
example.traditional: 佢公開拒絕回答議員問題，被指藐視立法會
example.jyutping: keoi5 gung1 hoi1 keoi5 zyut6 wui4 daap3 ji5 jyun4 man6 tai4 bei6 zi2 miu5 si6 lap6 faat3 wui6
